newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan to re-issue Sept reformate import tender.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan to re-issue Sept reformate import tender.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) will re-issue later on Monday a tender to buy 250,000 barrels of 95-octane unleaded reformate for September 1-30 delivery, a company official said.
The official did not specify how many cargoes CPC plans to buy in the new tender which seeks cargoes for the full month.
"It is subject on the number," he said. "If it is good we may take more than one, if it is still too high, we may cancel."
The tender which closes on August 11 and is valid for two days, seeks the cargo for delivery to Keelung, Kaohsiung, Shalung or Taichung on a cost-and-freight basis.
CPC last week cancelled its bi-monthly tender to buy reformate for September 1-15 due to high offers.
CPC was only prepared to accept offers of less than $25.00 per tonne and considered the lowest offer of around $25.30 too high.

The offers in the cancelled tender were also much higher than the awarded level in CPC's previous tender at $23.30 per barrel, c-and-f Taiwan, for August 11-20 delivery. The seller then was a Dutch trader, traders said.
